dedupe_keys.name: gtfs4ev gtfs based bus electrification planning tool

description: GTFS4EV is an open-source Python tool from the Photovoltaics and Thin Film Electronics Laboratory at EPFL for planning the electrification of public bus fleets. It simulates bus operations and charging demand from standard GTFS timetable data, without proprietary vehicle-level records, and sits between detailed fleet simulators and simple calculators. It validates and preprocesses the feed, simulates fleet operation, applies layered charging strategies, assesses solar integration and reports CO2, pollution and cost impacts, with a command-line and library interface and outputs as CSV and HTML. Support came from the HORIZON OpenMod4Africa initiative and the repository includes a case study on Lusaka minibus taxis. It is GPL-3.0 licensed and free, and commits run to 21 August 2026. Coverage is any city with a GTFS feed. Caveats: it is young, a software paper was in preparation, and results rest on assumed vehicle and charger parameters. It suits capacity planning and optimisation of bus charging and grid impact. Related catalogue records: model-routezero-electric-bus-depot-charging and model-bogota-electric-bus-depot-pv-battery-grid-capacity-optimisation.
